arguments.command:
python3 -c "
from more_itertools import seekable
from itertools import count

it = seekable((str(n) for n in count()))
result = next(it), next(it), next(it)
print(f'First 3: {result}')
assert result == ('0', '1', '2'), f'Expected (\"0\", \"1\", \"2\") got {result}'

it.relative_seek(1)
val = next(it)
print(f'After relative_seek(1), next: {val}')
assert val == '4', f'Expected \"4\" got {val}'

it.relative_seek(-2)
val = next(it)
print(f'After relative_seek(-2), next: {val}')
assert val == '2', f'Expected \"2\" got {val}'

print('Docstring test passed!')
" 2>&1
